meals.name: Sweet rice cake with jam
meals.ingredients: cooked short-grain rice 200g, egg 1, milk 50ml, strawberry jam 2 tbsp, sugar 1 tsp, pinch salt (makes 4)
meals.attribution: Allen Lim / Feed Zone Portables sweet rice cake, EF Pro Cycling team recipe (https://efprocycling.com/tips-recipes/team-recipe-on-the-bike-rice-cakes/); "honey on rice cakes" as pre-ride breakfast (styrkr.com)

cachedPages.title: Team recipe: On-the-bike rice cakes | EF Pro Cycling

meals.name: Quinoa porridge with berries & banana
meals.ingredients: quinoa 80g dry, water or oat milk 300ml, banana 1, mixed berries 80g, maple syrup 1 tbsp, cinnamon
meals.attribution: Luke Mathews, age-group Ironman, 4am pre-ride breakfast (gulfnews.com "I burn 8,000 calories"); triathlete.com quinoa breakfast cereal

meals.name: Overnight rice pudding with cinnamon & berries
meals.ingredients: cooked white rice 200g, milk 300ml, honey 2 tbsp, cinnamon, mixed berries 80g (makes 3)
meals.attribution: reported carb-loading breakfast in Feed Zone-adjacent content and r/AdvancedRunning / r/triathlon carb-load threads (commonly reported); The Pretty Bee-style oat-free rice pudding

meals.name: Idli with sambar & coconut chutney
meals.ingredients: idli (steamed rice-lentil cakes) 4, sambar (lentil-vegetable stew) 250ml, coconut chutney 2 tbsp (makes 4)
meals.attribution: South Indian breakfast staple, reported as a favoured light pre-training breakfast among Indian runners (commonly reported; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Idli)

meals.name: Poha with peanuts & peas
meals.ingredients: poha (flattened rice) 100g, peanuts 1 tbsp, onion ½, peas 50g, mustard seeds, curry leaves, turmeric, oil 1 tsp, lime
meals.attribution: everyday North/Central Indian breakfast, commonly reported as a light pre-run breakfast in Indian running-community write-ups

meals.name: Upma with vegetables
meals.ingredients: semolina (rava) 100g, oil 1 tbsp, mustard seeds, onion ½, carrot ½, peas 50g, green chilli, curry leaves, water 300ml
meals.attribution: South Indian breakfast staple, commonly reported among Indian endurance athletes in "what I eat" threads

meals.name: Bircher muesli
meals.ingredients: rolled oats 80g, apple juice or milk 150ml, plain yogurt 150g, apple 1 grated, sultanas 20g, cinnamon, honey 1 tbsp
meals.attribution: Jonny Brownlee's winter routine, made the night before and taken to morning swim sessions (220triathlon.com); Hannah Grant, Eat Race Win, WorldTour travel-breakfast staple (https://hannahgrant.com/)

meals.name: High-protein overnight oats
meals.ingredients: rolled oats 80g, Greek yogurt 150g, milk 150ml, protein powder ½ scoop, honey 1 tbsp, berries 80g (makes 5 jars)
meals.attribution: Alex Larson RDN (alexlarsonnutrition.com); Jan Frodeno's race-day "big bowl of overnight oats"; Kristian Blummenfelt preps overnight oats with yogurt and nuts the day before (vo2master.com Norwegian Method interview)

meals.name: Gluten-free pancakes with maple syrup
meals.ingredients: GF pancake mix 120g (or rice flour 50g + oat flour 50g), eggs 2, milk 200ml, maple syrup 3 tbsp, butter 1 tsp, banana 1 (makes 8 pancakes)
meals.attribution: Luke McKenzie, 6x Ironman champion — gluten-free pancakes and syrup as his go-to (active.com); Hannah Grant's GF pancakes with fruit salad for pro cycling teams (bikeradar.com Tour de France recipes)

meals.name: Buckwheat pancakes with honey & berries
meals.ingredients: 100% buckwheat flour 100g, eggs 2, rice milk 150ml, honey 2 tbsp, mixed berries 100g, baking powder ½ tsp
meals.attribution: trigirl.co.uk GF/DF triathlete breakfast list ("buckwheat pancakes with honey and berries")

meals.name: Banana-oat pancakes, egg-free
meals.ingredients: certified GF rolled oats 100g blended to flour, banana 2 mashed, oat milk 120ml, baking powder 1 tsp, cinnamon, plant protein 1 scoop optional
meals.attribution: standard flourless banana-oat pancake, widely cross-referenced in egg-free breakfast round-ups (Healthy Green Kitchen); vegan protein-pancake format from plant-based endurance content (veganeasy.org)

meals.name: Freezer waffles with Greek yogurt & berries
meals.ingredients: waffle batter (flour 150g, eggs 2, buttermilk 200ml, baking powder 1 tsp — makes 6), Greek yogurt 150g, mixed berries 100g, maple syrup 2 tbsp
meals.attribution: commonly reported weekend recovery breakfast among endurance athletes (marathonhandbook.com); "waffles with eggs, OJ and toast" post-workout in an age-group triathlete Substack (triplethreatlife.substack.com)

meals.name: Gluten-free French toast with maple & berries
meals.ingredients: GF bread 3 slices, eggs 2, rice milk 100ml, cinnamon, maple syrup 2 tbsp, berries 80g, oil for the pan (makes 2)
meals.attribution: runtothefinish.com gluten-free runner meal plan ("GF French toast, freezer-friendly"); studentathletenutrition.com GF recovery breakfast

meals.name: Rich Roll's green smoothie
meals.ingredients: kale or spinach 2 cups, beetroot 1 small, banana 2, mixed berries ½ cup, coconut water 300ml, chia 1 tbsp, hemp seeds 1 tbsp, flax 1 tbsp
meals.attribution: Rich Roll, vegan ultra-endurance athlete — his standard pre-workout green smoothie (https://www.richroll.com/blog/morning-pre-race-nutrition/; livekindly.com)
